Name: Teleport Mod
Author: Falson127
Description:
This mod gives a useful feature familiar to those who've ever played games like Diablo. Similar to a town portal, you can teleport back to a point on your farm (which you can set) and then return back to your previous location when you're ready. Each teleportation requires stamina, and the amount can be configured to your liking.

I tied this feature to the wizard so there would be more of a benefit to actually talking to him after the Junimo stuff early on. At 5 hearts he'll send a letter in the mail unlocking the ability to teleport. If you continue to 10 hearts (or 8 with Stardew Valley Expanded installed) you unlock the ability to remove the stamina cost. By default the stamina cost is 15 per teleport (30 per round trip), but if you want to just ignore that you can set it to 0 in the config file.

This mod supports the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿, allowing you to change settings in game

Default keys:
H - Teleport
J - Set Home Point
